{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Golden Claymore Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Gerudo Claymore Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Golden Claymore Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Gerudo Claymore Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |pronunciation= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 28 }} |durability= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 30 }} |comp= |sample= |theme= }} '''Gerudo Claymores''', also known as '''Golden Claymores''', are recurring [[Weapon]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Gerudo Claymore|Gerudo Claymores|Series, TotK, AoC, AoI}} | {{List| * {{TotK}} * {{AoC}} * {{AoI}} }} |- | {{Term/Store|Golden Claymore|Golden Claymores|BotW}} | {{BotW}} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 28 |durability = 30 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Golden Claymore}} Golden Claymores are two-handed [[Gerudo]] [[Weapon]]s that are commonly wielded by talented sword fighters. They belong to the [[Gerudo Gear]] equipment archetype. Due to being lighter than they appear, they are easy to wield. They are found in the [[Gerudo Highlands]] and [[Hyrule Ridge]], either abandoned in [[Treasure Chest]]s or being used by [[Enemy|Enemies]]. They also have a chance to appear in Treasure Chests that spawn after the {{SSB}} Series [[Ganondorf]] [[amiibo]] is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. [[Buliara]] carries one as she guards [[Riju's Throne]]. As metal Weapons, Golden Claymores will attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. They are unable to be burned by [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They can also be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] Rune on the [[Sheikah Slate]], which is useful as they sink in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_029" |Life = 30 |Power = 28 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 8 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 11 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 15 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 12 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 27 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 30 |BuyingPrice = 120 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Gerudo Claymore}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Two-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where the Item is found * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} An ancient version of the Gerudo Claymore appears in {{AoI}}, where it is wielded by several Gerudo Warriors, such as [[Ronza]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:AoC Gerudo Claymore Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for a Gerudo Claymore File:AoI Gerudo Claymore Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoI|-}}}}Icon for a Gerudo Claymore ==See Also== {{See Also| * Decayed Weapon * Gerudo Claymore✨ * Gerudo Gear * Two-Handed Weapon * Weapon }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Golden Claymore}}
